title: Premium Brand, Visual UX & Conversion-Polish
status: implementation complete, regression suite green, not deployed

findings.title: Regional-page primary hero CTA invisible on all 4 pages
findings.root_cause: leftover .hero-btns { display: none !important; } rule from a different context in a shared override stylesheet, never checked against the regional-page hero which needs the CTA visible

findings.title: Product-card images render distorted on category and regional pages
findings.root_cause: no stylesheet defined object-fit for .prod-img img; browser default fill stretched non-square photos (68/84 = 81% of product images are non-square, 45/84 = 54% have ratio outside 0.75-1.3) to fit an incorrectly hardcoded square 1024x1024 declared size from the Phase 10 category-page generator
findings.fix: added aspect-ratio:1/1 + overflow:hidden to .prod-img, and width:100%/height:100%/object-fit:cover to .prod-img img
findings.affected_pages: 10 Phase 10 category pages + europe-trade.html (5 product cards added in Phase 10); africa-trade.html and uae-trade.html already had equivalent local protection, now redundant but harmless

findings.title: Informal/inconsistent product photography style
findings.reason: requires real new product photography; this session cannot commission, source, or fabricate images. Documented as a future opportunity requiring real photography access.

design_improvements: uniform, non-distorted product-card image cropping across all category and regional pages using product cards
ux_improvements: restored primary hero CTA visibility on 4 regional trade pages
conversion_improvements: 4 regional pages regain their above-the-fold primary conversion action
category pages present a visually consistent, non-distorted product catalogue
accessibility_regressions: none - neither fix touches contrast, focus, semantics, or ARIA

performance_impact.bytes_added: net neutral (one rule removed, two small rules added to an already-loaded stylesheet)
